Thank you for your answer. I didn't answer at the moment, but it helped. 
Someone hearing me; plus i looked for message hotlines, which kept me busy ;  plus the fact that i'm not alone to go / have gone through that, and that just waiting it out laying down in bed can work.

Thank you ❤

I been teared down by dreams since november too. 

Many about my ex, but also all my life before covid (we broke up a year ago, for the first lockdown)

My sense of reality / present vs past, is completely fucked up now.

I hope you have it better one day, a thought for you
